# FG-AUTH-0031

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `org_binding_role_above_developer_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 組織の結び付けで付けられるのは Reporter か Developer までです。Maintainer・Owner はメンバーとして手で付けてください。
- en: An organisation binding gives Reporter or Developer only. Give Maintainer or Owner by adding the person as a member.
- id: Pengikatan organisasi hanya memberi Reporter atau Developer. Berikan Maintainer atau Owner dengan menambahkan orang itu sebagai anggota.

## 原因 (cause)

A binding was asked with the role `maintainer` or `owner`. ADR-0038 §2.1 caps bindings at Developer: protected branches, settings and deployment approval are never given by a change in the organisation alone, only by a person adding a member by hand. The table's CHECK `org_bindings_role_cap` is the backstop. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=role_above_cap`, `role` (the asked role) and `cap=developer`.

## 対処 (fix)

Bind with `reporter` or `developer`; add the few people who need Maintainer or Owner as members (members screen).
